trailhead.label: The Rifugio Cima Bossola, Località Marciana, the board’s start

cautions: A grassy ridge path (T2), steep in places: watch your dog’s footing and keep it close near the summit.
Open pastures with no shade: carry water for your dog on warm days.
Cows may graze on the pastures in summer: keep your dog on a short lead near the herd.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.The Rifugio Cima Bossola, Località Marci: Il Rifugio Cima Bossola, località Marciana, la partenza ufficiale
textIt.A grassy ridge path (T2), steep in place: Un sentiero di cresta erboso (T2), ripido in alcuni tratti: attenzione all’appoggio del cane e tienilo vicino in cima.
textIt.Open pastures with no shade: carry water: Pascoli aperti senza ombra: nelle giornate calde porta acqua per il cane.
textIt.Cows may graze on the pastures in summer: D’estate sui pascoli possono esserci mucche: vicino alla mandria tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
